title: Tandem Kayak Neon Night Paddle
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience Lake Pleasant from sunset into the night on a guided Ignite Series tour in a two-person tandem kayak. After a safety briefing, launch from shore as the Arizona sky changes color. When darkness falls, the kayak’s illuminated light system creates a colorful glow on the water. The listed price is for one tandem kayak and covers up to two guests—not a per-person price. Book one unit for each tandem kayak your group needs. A tandem kayak, paddles, life jackets, and lighting equipment are included.
